summary: Deploy the SUZHI Decentralized Eco-City dApp on the Internet Computer (ICP), including Internet Identity onboarding with sequential citizen IDs, an ICRC-1 SUZHI token (1B max supply), proof-of-contribution work logging with peer verification and automatic rewards, and a token-based DAO with proposals, voting, and automated execution, plus an earthy gold/brown dashboard UI.
architectural_notes: Use Internet Identity for authentication; map authenticated Principal -> citizen ID in a dedicated Citizen Registry canister.
Citizen ID assignment must be sequential and persisted across upgrades using stable memory (stable counter + stable mapping).
Token standard is ICRC-1; initialize with fixed max supply 1B and mint initial supply to a designated owner Principal.
Proof-of-contribution rewards are triggered only after 2 peer verifications; token transfers are executed by canister logic.
DAO governance uses token-weighted voting with fixed periods (7-day discussion, 5-day vote) and auto-execution on >50% approval.
UI theme palette: Gold #D4AF37, Brown #4B3621, Earthy #C2B280; core sections: profile/ID, wallet, contribution logger, governance portal.
known_issues: Owner Principal for initial minting is not yet provided (placeholder [INSERT_YOUR_PRINCIPAL_ID_HERE]).

existing_features.title: Integrate Internet Identity (II) authentication in the frontend so users can sign in/out and the app can call the backend as the authenticated principal.

Implement Proof of Contribution: allow users to create work logs in four categories (Physical, Knowledge, Creative, Wellness) and require exactly 2 peer verifications (unique verifiers, not the worker) before the backend automatically transfers SUZHI tokens to the worker.

Implement a DAO system in the Motoko backend for One Token, One Vote with: proposal submission (description, budget, timeline), a 7-day discussion period, a 5-day voting period, and automatic execution for proposals approved by >50% of votes.

Build the SUZHI dashboard UI with the specified Gold (#D4AF37), Brown (#4B3621), and Earthy (#C2B280) palette, and include the following sections: User Profile (show principal + unique citizen ID), Token Wallet (balance + transfer + optional buy placeholder), Contribution Logger (create/view/verify logs), and Governance Portal (view/submit/vote). All user-facing text must be in English.
Apply a coherent 'eco-city' visual theme consistent with the gold/brown/earthy palette (typography, spacing, components styling) across the app without introducing new product features.

new_feature_requests.summary: Integrate Internet Identity (II) authentication and a Citizen Registry canister that assigns sequential unique citizen IDs stored in stable memory
Implement SUZHI token canister using ICRC-1 with max supply 1,000,000,000; mint full supply to specified Principal; enable transfers
Build Proof of Contribution system: work logs in four categories (Physical/Knowledge/Creative/Wellness) requiring 2 peer verifications before automatic SUZHI token reward transfer
Implement DAO canister for One Token One Vote: proposal submission (description, budget, timeline), 7-day discussion, 5-day voting, and automatic execution if >50% approval
Design and build dashboard UI with gold/brown/earthy palette showing user profile (unique ID), token wallet, contribution logger, and governance portal
Add admin/distribution utility for testing (e.g., bulk airdrop/bulk transfer to many Principals) to fund ~100 testers quickly

Implement a Citizen Registry in the Motoko backend that assigns each newly onboarded principal a unique sequential citizen ID (1, 2, 3, ...) and persists the counter and registry mapping in stable memory across upgrades.
Implement the SUZHI token in the Motoko backend following the ICRC-1 standard interface, with max supply = 1,000,000,000 and fully transferable balances between users.

Mint the entire 1,000,000,000 SUZHI supply at initialization to the provided owner Principal ID "[INSERT_YOUR_PRINCIPAL_ID_HERE]", and provide a safe way to set/replace this placeholder with the real owner principal before production use.

Add an owner-restricted bulk distribution method `bulkAirdrop(recipients: [Principal], amount: Nat)` that transfers `amount` SUZHI to each recipient in a single call (or batched safely) to quickly fund ~100 testers.

Define a deterministic reward calculation for verified work logs and make the parameters configurable by an admin/owner (e.g., per-category base rate and/or per-hour rate), then use it for the automatic SUZHI reward transfer.
